package gocql
	type gocql.Batch struct
		field Kind cql.BatchKind
		method (*T) Len() int
		method (*T) Reset()
	type gocql.CASBatchRows[X any] struct
		method (T) Applied() (bool, error)
		method (T) Clone() (cql.CASResult[X], error)
		method (T) Close() error
		method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (T) Err() error
		method (T) Info() cql.Result
		method (T) NextInto(dst *cql.CASResult[X]) bool
		method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.CassandraV4 struct
	type gocql.CassandraV5 struct
	func gocql.Connect[D gocql.Dialect](ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config) (*gocql.Session[D], error)
	type gocql.Dialect interface (sealed)
	const gocql.MaxBatchStatements untyped int
	type gocql.Page[R any] struct
		method (*T) Clone() (R, error)
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Err() error
		method (*T) Info() cql.Result
		method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		method (*T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
		method (*T) State() cql.PageState
	type gocql.PageLease struct
		method (*T) Close()
	type gocql.Prepared[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Query(options exec.Options) (*gocql.Query[P, R], error)
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
	type gocql.PreparedInfo struct
		field Keyspace string
		field Table string
		field PartitionKeyIndexes []int
		field Kind cql.StatementKind
		field Conditional bool
		field Generation uint64
	type gocql.PreparedStream[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Info() gocql.PreparedInfo
		method (*T) Parameters() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Query(options exec.StreamOptions) (*gocql.StreamQuery[P, R], error)
	type gocql.Query[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) AddToBatch(batch *gocql.Batch, value P) error
		method (*T) All(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) Close()
		method (*T) Each(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Exec(ctx context.Context, value P) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) One(ctx context.Context, value P, dst *R) (bool, cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) Routing(value P) (routing.Info, error)
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunPage(ctx context.Context, value P, state cql.PageState, pageSize int32) (*gocql.Page[R], error)
		method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error
	type gocql.RowStream[R any] struct
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (*T) Err() error
		method (*T) Info() gocql.StreamInfo
		method (*T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
	type gocql.Rows[R any] struct
		method (T) Clone() (R, error)
		method (T) Close() error
		method (T) Columns() cql.Columns
		method (T) Err() error
		method (T) Info() cql.Result
		method (T) NextInto(dst *R) bool
		method (T) Retain() (*gocql.PageLease, error)
	type gocql.ScyllaV4 struct
	type gocql.Session[D gocql.Dialect] struct
		method (*T) AwaitSchemaAgreement(ctx context.Context) error
		method (*T) Close() error
		method (*T) Closed() bool
		method (*T) CompileOptions(options exec.Options) (exec.CompiledOptions, error)
		method (*T) ExecBatch(ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) ID() string
		method (*T) Metadata() *metadata.Snapshot
		method (*T) Metrics() metrics.Snapshot
		method (*T) Prepare[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.Prepared[P, R], error)
		method (*T) PrepareStream[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.StreamStatement[P, R], options ...exec.PrepareOptions) (*gocql.PreparedStream[P, R], error)
		method (*T) RefreshMetadata(ctx context.Context) error
		method (*T) RunBatch[R any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[R], options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.Rows[R], error)
		method (*T) RunConditionalBatch[X any](ctx context.Context, batch *gocql.Batch, decoder cql.RowDecoder[cql.CASResult[X]], options ...exec.CompiledOptions) (gocql.CASBatchRows[X], error)
		method (*T) Subscribe(filter event.Filter) (*event.Subscription, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedAddToBatch[P, R any](batch *gocql.Batch, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P) error
		method (*T) UnpreparedAll[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) iter.Seq2[*R, error]
		method (*T) UnpreparedEach[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, fn func(*R) error, options ...exec.Options) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedExec[P any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, cql.EmptyRow], value P, options ...exec.Options) (cql.Result, error)
		method (*T) UnpreparedOne[P, R any](ctx context.Context, statement cql.Statement[P, R], value P, dst *R, options ...exec.Options) (bool, cql.Result, error)
	var gocql.StopIteration error
	type gocql.StreamInfo struct
		field Result cql.Result
		field DeliveredRows int64
		field Pages int64
		field OutputStarted bool
	type gocql.StreamQuery[P any, R any] struct
		method (*T) Close()
		method (*T) Run(ctx context.Context, value P) (*gocql.RowStream[R], error)
		method (*T) Wait(ctx context.Context) error

package auth
	type auth.Exchange interface
		method Challenge(context.Context, cql.Nullable[cql.Bytes]) (cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)
		method Close()
		method Success(context.Context, cql.Nullable[cql.Bytes]) error
	func auth.Password(username string, password string) auth.Provider
	type auth.Provider interface
		method Start(context.Context, metadata.HostSnapshot, string) (auth.Exchange, cql.Nullable[[]byte], error)

package config
	type config.ClientRoute struct
		field ConnectionID string
		field Hostname string
	type config.ClientRoutes struct
		method (T) Routes() []config.ClientRoute
	type config.ClientRoutesBuilder struct
		method (*T) Build() (config.ClientRoutes, error)
		method (*T) WithRoute(connectionID string, hostname string) *config.ClientRoutesBuilder
	type config.Config struct
		method (T) String() string
	type config.ConfigBuilder struct
		method (*T) Build() (config.Config, error)
		method (*T) ConfigureDefaultProfile(choose func(*config.ProfileBuilder)) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) NoAdvancedShardAwareness() *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithAddressTranslator(translator endpoint.Translator) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithAdvancedShardAwareness(first uint16, last uint16) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithApplication(name string, version string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithAuth(provider auth.Provider) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithAutomaticSchemaAgreement(on bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithCQLVersion(version string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithClientID(id string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithClientRoutes(routes config.ClientRoutes) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithCoalesceWrites(wait time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithCompression(compression cql.Compression) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithConfigReport(on bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithConnectTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithConnectionsPerHost(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithConnectionsPerShard(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithContactPoints(contactPoints ...string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithConviction(policy endpoint.ConvictionPolicy) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithDNSTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithDefaultAdvancedShardAwareness() *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithDefaultProfile(profile config.Profile) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithDialer(dialer endpoint.Dialer) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithDiscovery(on bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithHeartbeat(interval time.Duration, timeout time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithHostFilter(keep func(metadata.HostSnapshot) bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithIgnoreEvents(kinds ...event.Kind) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithKeyspace(name string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithLifecycleObserver(observer observe.LifecycleObserver) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithLinger(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithLocalAddress(address net/netip.Addr) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithLogger(logger *log/slog.Logger) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxDecompressedSize(bytes int64) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxExcessPerShard(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxFrameSize(bytes int64) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxMetadataDepth(depth int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxOrphanedStreams(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxPagingStateSize(bytes int64) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxPagingStates(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMaxRequestsPerConnection(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMetadataKeyspaces(keyspaces ...string) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMetadataMode(mode metadata.Mode) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMetadataRefresh(interval time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMetadataServerTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithMetadataTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithNagle(on bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithObserver(observer observe.Observer) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithOnlyHost(id cql.UUID) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithPartitioner(name string, partitioner routing.TokenPartitioner) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithPort(port uint16) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithPreparedCacheSize(n int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithReadTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithReconnect(policy endpoint.ReconnectPolicy) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithRefreshAfterAgreement(on bool) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithResolver(resolver endpoint.Resolver) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithSchemaAgreement(timeout time.Duration, poll time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithServerTimestamps() *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithSocketBuffers(receive int, send int) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithTCPKeepalive(period time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithTLS(config *crypto/tls.Config) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithTLSSource(source endpoint.TLSSource) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithTimestampGenerator(next func() int64) *config.ConfigBuilder
		method (*T) WithWriteTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ConfigBuilder
	func config.New(contactPoints ...string) *config.ConfigBuilder
	func config.NewClientRoutes() *config.ClientRoutesBuilder
	func config.NewProfile() *config.ProfileBuilder
	func config.NewTLSFiles(base *crypto/tls.Config, files config.TLSFiles) (*config.TLSFileSource, error)
	type config.Profile struct
		field Retry retry.Policy
		field Routing routing.Policy
		field Speculation retry.SpeculationPolicy
		field Timeout time.Duration
		field PageTimeout time.Duration
		field Prefetch int
		field PageSize int32
		field SerialConsistency cql.Option[cql.Consistency]
		field Consistency cql.Consistency
	type config.ProfileBuilder struct
		method (*T) Build() (config.Profile, error)
		method (*T) NoPrefetch() *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) NoSerialConsistency() *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) NoTimeout() *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithConsistency(c cql.Consistency) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithPageSize(rows int32) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithPageTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithPrefetch(pages int) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithRetry(policy retry.Policy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithRouting(policy routing.Policy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithSerialConsistency(c cql.Consistency) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithSpeculation(policy retry.SpeculationPolicy) *config.ProfileBuilder
		method (*T) WithTimeout(d time.Duration) *config.ProfileBuilder
	type config.TLSFileSource struct
		method (*T) Err() error
		method (*T) Reload() error
		method (*T) TLSConfig() *crypto/tls.Config
	type config.TLSFiles struct
		field CertFile string
		field KeyFile string
		field CAFile string
		field Interval time.Duration

	type cql.Codec[T any] interface

		method Clone(T) T
